description: This Java source file defines the Android Fragment class `DeviceDetailFragment`, which manages UI interactions, device connection setup, file transfer, and server socket handling in a Wi-Fi Direct (P2P) Android application.

classes.name: DeviceDetailFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment that manages Wi-Fi Direct device interactions, including connection, data transfer, and establishing a server socket for file reception.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the fragment layout, sets up buttons and their click handlers for connect, disconnect, and file selection actions.

methods.name: onActivityResult
methods.description: Handles the result of an intent to select a file and initiates the file transfer via a background service.

methods.name: onConnectionInfoAvailable
methods.description: Updates UI based on connection info; starts a server socket if the device is group owner, enabling file reception.

methods.name: showDetails
methods.description: Displays device details in the UI.

methods.name: resetViews
methods.description: Resets UI elements after a disconnect.
